keyFindings.description: The head conflicts with main d86f8de8 in this file (GitHub mergeable CONFLICTING, mergeStateStatus DIRTY at 2026-11-01T10:09:53Z; git merge-tree names this one file). Merge main forward.

Main added its own migrations 0151-0157 after this branch's merge base 081e9e60. pgmigrate.Load refuses two forward migrations with one version, so after the forward merge every boot refuses. Renumber this branch's ten migrations 0158-0167 and every reference to their numbers.

One transaction takes SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on asks, comments, issues, messages and document_search in turn, under the runner's 5 s lock_timeout. A live writer that writes comments then asks (0066 names such writers) or that inserts a version (document_search through 0156's trigger) and then updates issues closes a cycle: 40P01 aborts the writer (500) or the migration (no retry, boot fails). Use 0066's set local lock_timeout = '500ms' or one migration per table, and correct the comment at lines 24-34.

The four item triggers fire on the source columns but not on update of search, which 0156 lists for the same reason. api/related_recall_test.go empties issues.search directly and then restores it, so each staged pair adds the query's words a second time. Because the refresh now never rebuilds a project in full in steady state, a write that misses the queue stays counted wrong.

The backfill inserts every document's row in one transaction. A version write to a document it already filled waits on that uncommitted row through 0156's on-conflict insert, for the rest of the backfill. The comment says only an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE holder is waited behind. Measure the backfill on the production-shaped census database and state the stall, or fill in committed batches.
Seed runs database.Migrate before refuseFilledDatabase, so a wrong --database-url that names a live database gets this build's migrations before the tool refuses it. Refuse first.

The server's api package carries the previous release's term-statistics build only for cmd/dispatch-seed and the oracle test; its package variables are in the server binary. Move the build to cmd/dispatch-seed and the oracle to a _test.go file, and fix the RefreshEverySearchTermStats comment that says it is exported for a function of its own package.

TestTheAuditedReadsReturnTheRowsMainsStatementsDo compares each statement with a byte-identical copy of itself, which tests Postgres, and TestTheUnusedOpenArtifactAskIndexIsDropped repeats store_test.go's assertDatabaseObjectsAbsent. Delete both and add asks_open_artifact to the store test's absent list.

The generic-plan helper is copied three times (genericPlan, auditedReadPlan, anchorReadPlan) and the index-keyed scan loop seven times. Put one of each in explaintest, which this change already extends.
graph.go grows to 1109 lines. The backlink count block stands alone and its test file is backlink_counts_test.go; move it to backlink_counts.go.

Comments and log labels name 'main', 'this branch', 'the review's finding N' and 'the plan's answer N' (benchtime.go, cmd/dispatch-seed run.go, report.go, settle.go, words.go, write_docs.go, write_events.go, docs/marks.go anchoredOn). After the merge these name nothing a reader can find. Name the release or migration and write the reason.
openAnchoredMarksQuery chooses the open predicate by comparing target.table with "comments", and edits.go spells the two predicates again. Put an open field on anchorTarget.
